WIZARD.DEVICE_SUCCESSFULLY_CONFIGURED: Last wizard screen title fragment: preceded by the device name and a space (e.g. 'Volumio' + this), so the device name is the sentence subject.
WIZARD.PLEASE_DONATE: Message on the last screen of the first-run wizard (only on DIY installs, not Volumio hardware) inviting users to donate money to support the Volumio project.
WIZARD.RUN_FIRST_CONFIG_WIZARD: Button in System settings: starts the first-run setup wizard again (language, name, audio output, network, etc.). Verb: run = launch.
SLEEP.POWER_OFF: Option in the Sleep timer dialog (side menu) for what happens when the timer ends: shut down the device. Action noun/verb phrase.
SLEEP.STOP_MUSIC: Option in the Sleep timer dialog (side menu) for what happens when the timer ends: stop playback but keep the device on.
SLEEP.PRESET_TIMES: Small heading above the dropdown of ready-made durations (15 min, 30 min, 1 hr...) in the Sleep timer dialog.
SLEEP.CHOOSE_PRESET: Placeholder text in the Sleep timer dialog's dropdown of ready-made durations, shown before the user picks one.
SLEEP.HR: Abbreviation for hour(s) in the Sleep timer preset list, shown after a number with a space (e.g. '1 hr', '2 hr'). Keep it very short.
SLEEP.MIN: Abbreviation for minutes in the Sleep timer preset list, shown after a number with a space (e.g. '15 min', '30 min'). Keep it very short.
SLEEP.OFF: First option in the Sleep timer preset list: no timer / sleep timer disabled. Adjective state, not a verb.
ALARM.CRATE_PLAYLIST_FIRST: Message in the Alarm Clock dialog (side menu) when no playlists exist: the alarm plays a playlist, so the user must create one before setting an alarm.
ALARM.ALARM_CLOCK_SAVE: Success toast message (title 'Alarm Clock') after saving the alarm settings: the wake-up alarm is now scheduled.
ALARM.ALARM_CLOCK_TITLE: Name of the Alarm Clock feature (wakes the user by playing a playlist at a set time), used as toast title for alarm save confirmations and errors.
ALARM.PLAYLIST_SELECT_ERROR: Error toast message (title 'Alarm Clock') when saving an alarm without choosing which playlist it should play.
ALARM.SLEEP_MODE_HOUR: Toast fragment for Sleep timer: after the hour count + space; the minute count then follows directly with no space, then ' ' + 'minute(s)'.
ALARM.SLEEP_MODE_IN: Word between the action label and the remaining time in the Sleep timer toast: SLEEP_MODE_SYSTEM_WILL + action label + this + N + unit, joined with spaces (e.g. 'Scheduled: Turn off in 30 min'). A dash is fine where no preposition fits before a number.
ALARM.SLEEP_MODE_MINUTE: Toast fragment for Sleep timer: last word of 'The system will [action] in [N] minute(s)', after the minute count and a space; (s) covers singular/plural.
ALARM.SLEEP_MODE_SYSTEM_WILL: Lead-in of the Sleep timer toast: this + ' ' + action label (TURN_OFF / STOP_MUSIC, which must stay standalone labels) + ' ' + SLEEP_MODE_IN + ' ' + N + ' ' + unit. If the sentence can't work with a label, write a label-style lead-in such as 'Scheduled:'.
ALARM.SLEEP_MODE_TITLE: Toast title confirming the Sleep timer (stops music or turns off the device after a set time) was set.
ALARM.STOP_MUSIC: Sleep timer action 'stop playback'. Two uses: the standalone option label in the Sleep dialog's action dropdown, and inserted in the confirmation toast SLEEP_MODE_SYSTEM_WILL + this + SLEEP_MODE_IN + N + unit. Keep it a standalone label; put toast grammar in SLEEP_MODE_SYSTEM_WILL/IN.
ALARM.TIME_SELECT_ERROR: Error toast message (title 'Alarm Clock') when saving an alarm without choosing the time it should go off.
ALARM.TURN_OFF: Sleep timer action 'power off the device'. Two uses: the standalone option label in the Sleep dialog's action dropdown, and inserted in the confirmation toast SLEEP_MODE_SYSTEM_WILL + this + SLEEP_MODE_IN + N + unit. Keep it a standalone label; put toast grammar in SLEEP_MODE_SYSTEM_WILL/IN.
MULTIDEVICE.EDIT_GROUPS: Button/menu entry in multiroom: change which devices are grouped together to play the same music in sync. Verb 'edit'. No render site found.
MULTIDEVICE.ROOMS_AND_GROUPS: Title for the multiroom area listing rooms (single devices) and groups of devices playing in sync. No render site found.
MULTIDEVICE.MULTI_ROOM_CONFIGURATION: Title for the multiroom settings: configuring several devices in different rooms to play music together. No render site found.
MULTIDEVICE.GROUP: Multiroom: a set of devices playing the same music in sync. Likely a noun label; could also be a 'group these' button. No render site found.
MULTIDEVICE.NOW_PLAYING: Label in the multiroom/outputs panel for what a device or group is currently playing. No render site found.
MULTIDEVICE.PLAYBACK_ZONES: Multiroom title: zones are rooms/devices or groups that each play their own music. No render site found.
MULTIDEVICE.ZONES: Short multiroom title: zones are rooms/devices or groups that each play their own music. No render site found.
MULTIDEVICE.ZONES_AND_OUTPUTS: Tooltip on the speaker button in the player footer that opens the panel to choose which device/room (zone) and audio output plays the music.
MULTIDEVICE.GROUP_DEVICES: Tooltip on the button and title of the view in the outputs panel where the user groups several devices to play the same music in sync. Verb 'group'.
MULTIDEVICE.THIS_DEVICE: Small caption/subtitle in the outputs panel marking the device the user is currently controlling (as opposed to other devices on the network).
MULTIDEVICE.ACTIVE_GROUP: Subtitle in the outputs panel above the list of device groups currently playing together in sync.
MULTIDEVICE.REMOVE_ALL_DEVICES: Button in the audio outputs (multiroom) panel of the classic web UI; ungroups every other device from the current playback group so only this one plays.
MULTIDEVICE.AVAILABLE_DEVICES: Small subtitle in the audio outputs panel, above the list of other Volumio devices on the network that can be grouped, controlled or cast to.
MULTIDEVICE.SYNCED_PLAYBACK_NOT_AVAILABL: Status line under a device name in the multiroom grouping list; this device can't join a synchronized (multiroom) playback group.
MULTIDEVICE.GROUP_LEADER: Small label under a device name in a multiroom group; marks the device that leads the group (the one others sync playback to).
MULTIDEVICE.REMOTE_CONTROL_DEVICES: Tooltip on the 'Switch device' toggle in the audio outputs panel; opens the list of other Volumio devices this UI can control remotely.
MULTIDEVICE.ACTIVE_DEVICES: Small subtitle in the Cast section of the audio outputs panel, above the cast devices currently receiving audio.
MULTIDEVICE.CAST_DEVICES: Tooltip/heading in the audio outputs panel for the Cast section listing Chromecast-type speakers that audio can be sent to.
MULTIDEVICE.LOCAL_PLAYBACK: Tooltip on the toggle in the audio outputs panel that makes the browser/phone you are using play the audio itself (local playback). Same English as CONTINUE_PLAYING, different button.
MULTIDEVICE.CONTINUE_PLAYING: Button in the local playback popup, next to Disable; confirms and starts playing the audio on this browser/phone. Same English as LOCAL_PLAYBACK, different button.
MULTIDEVICE.LOCAL_PLAYBACK_ENABLED: Title of the local playback view in the audio outputs panel; status that audio is now playing on this browser/phone.
MULTIDEVICE.INPUTS: Name of the browse source for the device's audio inputs (e.g. analog line-in, digital inputs) in the music library, and a section label in the audio outputs panel. Noun, plural.
MULTIDEVICE.PRESETS: Label next to a dropdown in the DSP view of the audio outputs panel; picks a saved sound/DSP preset (e.g. EQ setup). Noun, plural.
MULTIDEVICE.GROUPING: Short caption under a round toggle button in the audio outputs panel; opens multiroom grouping of several speakers. Tight space.
MULTIDEVICE.CAST: Short caption under a round toggle button in the audio outputs panel; opens the list of Chromecast-type devices to send audio to. Tight space.
MULTIDEVICE.SWITCH_DEVICE: Short caption (verb) under a round toggle button in the audio outputs panel; lets you pick another Volumio device to control. Tight space.
MULTIDEVICE.NO_CAST_DEVICES: Empty-state text in the Cast section of the audio outputs panel when no cast-capable speakers are found on the network.
MULTIDEVICE.NO_GROUPABLE_DEVICES: Empty-state text in the multiroom grouping section when no other devices that can join a group are found on the network.
SIDEMENU.ANALOG_INPUT: Side menu entry in the classic web UI, all caps; opens the device's analog line-in source to play external audio.
SIDEMENU.BLUETOOTH: Side menu entry in the classic web UI, all caps; opens the Bluetooth source (playing from a paired phone). Brand name.
SIDEMENU.NOVA_BANNER_BADGE: Tiny badge next to the 'Nova is here' banner title in the side menu; marks it as new. Very tight space, one short word.
SIDEMENU.NOVA_BANNER_TITLE: Title of a promo banner in the classic web UI side menu announcing Nova, the new Volumio user interface (Nova is a product name).
SIDEMENU.NOVA_BANNER_SUBTITLE: Subtitle of the Nova promo banner in the side menu; tapping the banner switches the device to the new Nova interface.
SIDEMENU.NOVA_BANNER_TOOLTIP: Tooltip on the Nova promo banner in the side menu; explains the tap switches this device's interface to Nova and the user can switch back anytime.
MYVOLUMIO.MY_VOLUMIO: Product name of the MyVolumio cloud account/subscription service; used as page title and card heading on account, plan and password pages. Usually kept as is.
MYVOLUMIO.ERROR: Generic error dialog title for MyVolumio account, sign-in and payment failures; the body holds the specific error.
MYVOLUMIO.LOGIN: Button (verb) and sign-in dialog title on MyVolumio account pages; signs in to the MyVolumio account.
MYVOLUMIO.LOGOUT: Button (verb) on the MyVolumio profile, header and account pages; signs out of the MyVolumio account on this device.
MYVOLUMIO.SIGNUP: Button (verb) on MyVolumio access, login and profile pages; opens account creation for a new MyVolumio account.
MYVOLUMIO.SIGNUP_TO: Page title of the MyVolumio account creation form.
MYVOLUMIO.EMAIL_ADDRESS: Form field label/placeholder on MyVolumio sign-in, sign-up and edit profile forms.
MYVOLUMIO.PASSWORD: Form field label/placeholder for the account password on MyVolumio sign-in, sign-up and edit profile forms.
MYVOLUMIO.PAYMENT_SUCCESS: Heading on the page shown after a MyVolumio subscription payment goes through.
MYVOLUMIO.PAYMENT_FAIL: Heading on the payment-failed page and error dialog message when a MyVolumio subscription payment doesn't go through.
MYVOLUMIO.PLANS: Panel/page title of the MyVolumio subscription plans page (Free, Premium etc.); noun, plural.

MYVOLUMIO.UPGRADE_YOUR_PLAN_NOW: Call-to-action button or link to move to a higher MyVolumio subscription plan. No render site found.

MYVOLUMIO_PLANS.LATEST_NEWS: Feature line in the list of what a MyVolumio plan includes, on the plan comparison cards (older Free plan): the user gets MyVolumio news updates.
MYVOLUMIO_PLANS.MYVOLUMIO_1_DEVICE: Feature line on a MyVolumio plan comparison card: the account can be used on one device only.
MYVOLUMIO_PLANS.REMOTE_CONNECTION_1_DEVI: Feature line on a MyVolumio plan comparison card: control one device from outside the home network (over the internet).

MYVOLUMIO_PLANS.AUTO_SYNC: Feature line on MyVolumio plan comparison cards: the user's own favorites, playlists and radios are synced automatically between devices.

MYVOLUMIO_PLANS.CD_PLAYBACK_RIPPING: Feature line on MyVolumio plan comparison cards: play audio CDs from a USB drive and rip them (copy tracks to music files).

MYVOLUMIO_PLANS.MUSIC_METADATA: Feature bullet on paid MyVolumio plan cards (Premium/Superstar): browse extra info about music and the credits of artists/musicians on a recording.

APPEARANCE.DISPLAY_ON: Switch label in Appearance > Front display (Rivo Ultra): turns the player's front screen on or off.
APPEARANCE.DISPLAY_ON_DOC: Help text under the Display on switch, Front display: when off, the front screen stays dark even after standby or restart, until switched on again.
MAIN_MENU.ALARM: Entry in the main settings menu: opens the alarm clock settings (wake up to music at a set time). Noun.
MAIN_MENU.APPEARANCE: Entry in the main settings menu: opens the Appearance settings (language, theme, background, display).
MAIN_MENU.CREDITS: Entry in the main settings menu: opens the page acknowledging the people and open-source projects behind Volumio. No render site found.
MAIN_MENU.HELP: Entry in the main settings menu: opens help and support resources.
MAIN_MENU.MY_MUSIC: Entry in the main settings menu: opens My Music settings (music library, network drives, storage). No render site found.
MAIN_MENU.NETWORK: Entry in the main settings menu: opens the network settings (Wi-Fi, Ethernet, hotspot).
MAIN_MENU.PLAYBACK_OPTIONS: Entry in the main settings menu: opens Playback Options (audio output, DAC, volume, resampling).
MAIN_MENU.PLUGINS: Entry in the main settings menu: opens the Plugins page to install and manage add-ons.
MAIN_MENU.SHUTDOWN: Entry in the main settings menu: opens the power options to turn off or restart the device. Noun/verb as a menu command.
MAIN_MENU.SLEEP: Entry in the main settings menu: opens the sleep timer, which stops playback or turns the device off after a set time.
MAIN_MENU.SOURCES: Entry in the main settings menu: opens Sources, where music services and inputs are managed. No render site found.
MAIN_MENU.SYSTEM: Entry in the main settings menu: opens System settings (device name, updates, factory reset).
MAIN_MENU.MUSIC: Entry in the main settings menu: opens music library and sources settings.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.ADVANCED_AUDIO_TWEAKS: Section title in Playback Options for expert audio settings (fine-tuning beyond the basics). No render site found.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.ADVANCED_DAC_DSP_OPTION: Playback Options section title; code prefixes the DAC name and a space. Also toast title after enabling a DSP filter. DSP = digital signal processing on the DAC chip.
Help text under the DAC DSP Options section, Playback Options: special processing settings only some I2S DACs (add-on audio boards) support.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.AUDIO_BUFFER_SIZE: Setting label in Playback Options: amount of audio held in memory ahead of playback. Noun.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.AUDIO_BUFFER_SIZE_DOC: Help text under Audio buffer size, Playback Options: a bigger buffer reduces dropouts (stuttering) when streaming over the network.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.AUDIO_OUTPUT: Section title in Playback Options where the user picks the output device (DAC, HDMI, headphone jack) that plays the sound.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.AUDIO_RESAMPLING: Section title and switch label in Playback Options, also toast title on save. Resampling = converting audio to another sample rate/bit depth.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.AUDIO_RESAMPLING_DOC: Help text under the Audio Resampling switch: applies only to local files, not AirPlay (Shairport) or third-party services like Roon.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.AUDIO_RESAMPLING_SETTIN: Success toast message after saving the Audio Resampling section in Playback Options.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.BUFFER_BEFORE_PLAY: Select label in Playback Options: how much audio is preloaded before playback starts, to avoid initial dropouts.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.BUFFER_BEFORE_PLAY_DOC: Help text under the hidden 'Buffer before play' setting in Playback Options: how full the audio buffer must be before a track starts; raise it if audio stutters when skipping tracks by hand.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.CONNECT_OUTPUT_DEVICE_1: Start of a dialog message when the selected audio output is missing; code joins this + ' ' + output device name + ' ' + 'to the unit or select a different output device...'. Imperative: plug the device in.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.CONNECT_OUTPUT_DEVICE_2: End of a dialog message when the selected audio output is missing; preceded by 'Please connect' + ' ' + output device name + ' '. Tells the user to plug it into the player or pick another output in Playback Options.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.DEFAULT_STARTUP_VOLUME: Setting label (dropdown) in Playback Options > Volume: the volume level the player is set to every time it boots; options are Disabled or a level.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.DEFAULT_STARTUP_VOLUME_: Help text under the Default Startup Volume setting in Playback Options: the volume applied automatically when the system starts up.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.DOP: Option of the DSD Playback Mode dropdown in Playback Options: DoP sends DSD (Direct Stream Digital, a hi-res audio format) wrapped inside PCM frames to the DAC. Keep the abbreviations.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.DSD_AUTO_VOLUME: Switch label in Playback Options: when on, volume is automatically set to 100 while DSD (a hi-res audio format) is playing.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.DSD_AUTO_VOLUME_DOC: Help text under the DSD Auto Volume Level switch in Playback Options: DSD needs volume at 100, so when enabled volume jumps to 100 while DSD plays; warns to use carefully (loudness).
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.DSD_DIRECT: Option (and default) of the DSD Playback Mode dropdown in Playback Options: DSD audio is sent natively to the DAC when supported, otherwise converted to PCM.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.DSD_DOC: Help text under the DSD Playback Mode dropdown in Playback Options: explains Direct (native DSD, or on-the-fly PCM conversion if the DAC lacks DSD) vs DoP (DSD packed in 24-bit PCM).
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.DSD_PLAYBACK_MODE: Setting label (dropdown) in Playback Options: how DSD (Direct Stream Digital, hi-res audio) files are sent to the DAC; options DSD Direct or DSD over PCM (DoP).
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.DSP_PROGRAM_ENABLED: Title of the reboot dialog and success toast message after choosing a DSP program (built-in DAC sound-processing filter) in Playback Options > advanced DAC options. Past-tense status.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.DSP_PROGRAM_REBOOT: Body of the dialog after selecting a DSP program (DAC sound-processing filter) in Playback Options: the device must restart for it to take effect. Dialog offers restart buttons.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.ENABLE_I2S_DAC: Help text under the hidden 'I2S DAC' switch in Playback Options: turns on support for I2S DACs (audio boards plugged directly onto the board's GPIO header, e.g. Raspberry Pi HATs).
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.EXTENDED_FILE_FORMAT_SU: Switch label in the music library / network drives settings: reads many more audio file formats (via an extra decoder) at the cost of slower library scans.
Help text under the Extended File Format Support switch: enables reading many audio formats but slows building the music library; when off, most formats still play and scanning is faster.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.GAPLESS_MP3_PLAYBACK: No render site found; likely a switch label in Playback Options: plays consecutive MP3 tracks without a silent gap between them (gapless = no pause between tracks).
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.HARDWARE: Option of the Mixer Type dropdown in Playback Options > Volume: volume is controlled by the DAC/sound card's own hardware, without quality loss. Adjective/noun, short.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.HIGH: Option (and default) of the Resampling Quality/algorithm dropdown in Playback Options, between Very High and Medium. Quality level adjective, short.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.I2S_DAC_ACTIVATED: Title of the dialog shown after selecting an I2S DAC (audio board attached to the device's GPIO pins) in Playback Options or the setup wizard; it now needs a restart. Past-tense status.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.I2S_DAC_ACTIVATED_MESSA: Dialog message fragment: code puts the I2S DAC board name + ' ' before it. Says the DAC was turned on and the system must be restarted for it to work. Starts lowercase.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.I2S_DAC_DEACTIVATED: Title of a dialog (code currently commented out) after turning off an I2S DAC (audio board on the GPIO pins) in Playback Options; restart needed. Past-tense status.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.I2S_DAC_DEACTIVATED_MES: Dialog message fragment (code currently commented out): preceded by the I2S DAC board name + ' '. Says it was turned off and a system restart is needed. Starts lowercase.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.ISO_PLAYBACK: Hidden switch label in Playback Options: enables playing ISO disc image files (e.g. SACD rips) using an experimental player build.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.ISO_PLAYBACK_DOC: Help text under the ISO Playback switch: uses an experimental MPD (the music player engine) build that can play ISO disc image files; native DSD output is lost when on.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.LINEAR: Option of the hidden Volume Curve Mode dropdown in Playback Options: volume changes in equal steps across the range (vs the 'Natural' logarithmic curve). Adjective, short.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.LOW: Option of the Resampling Quality/algorithm dropdown in Playback Options, the lowest quality (least CPU). Quality level adjective, short.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.MAX_VOLUME_LEVEL: Setting label (dropdown of levels up to 100) in Playback Options > Volume: the highest volume the player can be set to.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.MAX_VOLUME_LEVEL_DOC: Help text under the Max Volume Level setting in Playback Options: caps the system volume at the chosen level.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.MEDIUM: Option of the Resampling Quality/algorithm dropdown in Playback Options, between High and Low. Quality level adjective, short.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.MIXER_CONTROL: No render site found; likely a label in Playback Options > Volume for the sound card's volume control (mixer = the audio device's volume/level control). Noun.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.MIXER_CONTROLS: Toast title after saving the volume settings in Playback Options; names the section (mixer = the audio device's volume controls). Noun, short.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.MIXER_CONTROLS_UPDATE: Success toast message after saving the volume (mixer) settings in Playback Options: the new settings were saved. Past-tense status.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.MIXER_CONTROL_NAME: Setting label (dropdown) in Playback Options > Volume, shown with Hardware mixer: which of the sound card's volume controls (mixer channels) Volumio uses.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.MIXER_CONTROL_NAME_DOC: Help text under Mixer Control Name in Playback Options: picks which of the audio device's volume controls is used; keep the default unless volume does not change when adjusted in the app.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.MIXER_TYPE: Setting label (dropdown) in Playback Options > Volume: how volume is controlled; options None, Software, Hardware (mixer = volume control).
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.MIXER_TYPE_DOC: Help text under Mixer Type in Playback Options: None = no volume control; Software = volume control with some quality loss; Hardware = volume control without loss. Keep option names matching their labels.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.MPD_VOLUME: Hidden switch label in Playback Options: lets MPD client apps (third-party remote apps using the MPD protocol) change the player's volume.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.MPD_VOLUME_DOC: Help text under the MPD Clients Volume Control switch: allows MPD protocol remote apps to set volume, but volume changes become slower.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.NATIVE: Option (and default) of the resampling Target Bit Depth and Target Sample Rate dropdowns in Playback Options: keep the file's original value, no conversion. Adjective, short.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.NATURAL: Select option (and default value) of the Volume Curve Mode setting on the Playback Options page: the logarithmic volume curve that matches how the ear perceives loudness. Adjective; opposite option is linear.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.NO_AUDIO_DEVICE_AVAILAB: Shown in place of a device name in the Output Device list on the Playback Options page when the system detects no sound card/DAC at all. Status text, not a dialog.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.NO_HARDWARE_MIXER: Status/option text in the mixer settings on the Playback Options page: the selected audio output has no built-in (hardware) volume control. No render site found.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.NO_OUTPUT_DEVICE: Title of a large dialog shown when the system finds no audio output device (no sound card/DAC); body asks to connect one, button 'Got it'.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.NO_OUTPUT_DEVICE_MESSAG: Body of the 'No Audio Output Available' dialog: asks the user to plug an audio output device (DAC, sound card, HAT) into the player. 'Unit' = the Volumio player itself.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.ONE_CLICK_VOLUME_STEPS: Setting label (select of numbers) on the Playback Options page, Volume section: how much the volume changes per single press of the + or - volume button.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.ONE_CLICK_VOLUME_STEPS_: Help text under the One Click Volume Steps setting on the Playback Options page: sets the volume increment for each single tap of the + and - buttons.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.OUTPUT_DEVICE: Setting label (select) on the Playback Options page, Audio Output section: which sound card/DAC the player sends audio to.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.OUTPUT_DEVICE_DOC: Help text under the Output Device setting on the Playback Options page: choose the audio output (sound card/DAC) among those detected on the device.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.OUTPUT_DEVICE_NOT_AVAIL: Title of a large dialog when the previously chosen audio output (e.g. a USB DAC) is no longer detected; body asks to reconnect it by name, button 'Got it'.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.PERSISTENT_QUEUE: Switch label on the Playback Options page: keep the play queue (list of tracks to play) after a restart. 'Persistent' = kept, saved.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.PERSISTENT_QUEUE_DOC: Help text under the Persistent queue switch on the Playback Options page: on = the play queue survives a reboot; off = the queue is emptied at every startup.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.PLAYBACK_MODE: Setting label (select: Continuous / Single) in the General Playback options section: what gets queued when the user plays a track from an album or playlist.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.PLAYBACK_MODE_CONTINUOU: Select option (and default) of the Playback Mode setting: tapping a track queues the whole album or playlist so playback continues. Adjective.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.PLAYBACK_MODE_DOC: Help text under the Playback Mode setting: Continuous queues all songs of the album/playlist, Single queues only the tapped song. Option names should match their labels.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.PLAYBACK_MODE_SINGLE: Select option of the Playback Mode setting: tapping a track adds only that one song to the queue. Adjective, means 'one track', not 'unmarried'.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.PLAYBACK_OPTIONS_TITLE: Page title of the Playback Options settings page and title of its general section; also dialog/toast title, joined in code with ': ISO Playback' after it.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.RESAMPLING_ALG: Setting label (select: Very high / High / ...) in the Resampling section of the Playback Options page: quality of the sample-rate conversion algorithm.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.RESAMPLING_ALG_DOC: Help text under the resampling quality setting: higher quality needs more CPU, so audio may stutter on weak devices; lower it until playback is smooth.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.SETTING_ERROR: Generic error title (toast or dialog) on the Playback Options page when saving an audio setting fails. Noun. No render site found.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.SOFTVOL: Option/value label in the mixer control select on the Playback Options page: volume adjusted digitally by the software (the 'SoftMaster' mixer), not by the DAC hardware.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.SOFTWARE: Select option of the Mixer Type setting on the Playback Options page: volume is controlled in software. Adjective, paired with Hardware and None options.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.TARGET_BITDEPTH: Setting label and help text (select) in the Resampling section of the Playback Options page: the bit depth (e.g. 16/24/32 bit) audio is converted to before output.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.TARGET_SAMPLERATE: Setting label and help text (select, e.g. 44.1 kHz to 384 kHz) in the Resampling section of the Playback Options page: the sample rate audio is converted to before output.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.USB_DAC_CONNECTED: Success toast title when a USB DAC (external digital-to-analog converter) is plugged in and selected as output; the toast message is the DAC's name.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.VERY_HIGH: Select option of the resampling algorithm quality setting on the Playback Options page: the highest quality level (most CPU use).
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.VOLUME_CURVE_MODE: Setting label (select: Natural / Linear) in the Volume options section of the Playback Options page: how the volume slider position maps to loudness.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.VOLUME_CURVE_MODE_DOC: Help text under Volume Curve Mode: Natural (logarithmic) matches how people hear loudness changes; change only if volume rises too steeply on your system.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.VOLUME_NORMALIZATION: Switch label on the Playback Options page: automatically even out loudness differences between tracks during playback.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.VOLUME_NORMALIZATION_DO: Help text under the Volume normalization switch: when on, Volumio evens out track loudness while playing, which may lower sound quality.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.VOLUME_OPTIONS: Section title on the Playback Options page grouping volume settings (mixer type, volume steps, curve, max/start volume).
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.SQ_QUALITY_TITLE: Section/setting title for the streaming sound quality choice of a music streaming service (MP3, FLAC, Hi-Res levels). No render site found.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.SQ_MP3_320: Select option in the streaming sound quality setting: compressed MP3 at 320 kbit/s. Keep the format name and units. No render site found.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.SQ_FLAC_LOSSLESS: Select option in the streaming sound quality setting: FLAC format, lossless (CD quality, no data lost in compression). No render site found.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.SQ_FLAC_HIRES_96: Select option in the streaming sound quality setting: high-resolution FLAC, 24-bit, sample rate up to 96 kHz. Keep the units. No render site found.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.SQ_FLAC_HIRES_192: Select option in the streaming sound quality setting: high-resolution FLAC, 24-bit, sample rate up to 192 kHz. Keep the units. No render site found.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.SQ_QUALITY_DESC: Help text under the streaming sound quality setting: pick the audio quality the music service streams at. No render site found.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.SQ_LOW: Select option in the streaming sound quality setting: lowest quality level (smallest data use). Adjective. No render site found.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.SQ_HIGH: Select option in the streaming sound quality setting: high quality level (compressed). Adjective. No render site found.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.SQ_LOSSLESS: Select option in the streaming sound quality setting: lossless quality, no audio data removed by compression. Adjective. No render site found.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.SQ_HI_RES: Option in a sound/streaming quality selector: high-resolution audio (better than CD quality). Hi-Res is a common audio term, often kept. No render site found.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.SQ_HIGHEST_POSSIBLE: Option in a sound/streaming quality selector: always use the best quality the source and output device support. No render site found.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.OUTPUT_DEVICE_NOT_AVAIL: Error message shown when playback fails because the chosen audio output (DAC, USB or HDMI device) is missing; asks the user to plug it in and switch it on.
PLAYBACK_OPTIONS.OUTPUT_DEVICE_BUSY: Error message shown when playback fails because another app is already using the chosen audio output device; asks to stop that playback first.
PLAYLIST.ADDED_TITLE: Success toast title after adding a track, album or station to a playlist or to Favorites; the message below says what was added where. Past participle.
PLAYLIST.ADDED_TO_FAVOURITES: Fragment of a toast message: joined right after the item title (or URI), e.g. '<title> to Favorites '. Keep the leading and trailing spaces. Favorites = the user's favourites list.
PLAYLIST.ADDED_TO_PLAYLIST: Fragment of a toast message: item title + this + playlist name, e.g. '<title> to playlist <name>'. Keep the leading and trailing spaces.
PLAYLIST.REMOVE_ERROR: Error toast title when an item cannot be removed from a playlist; the message shows the item name or URI. Verb phrase, short.
PLAYLIST.REMOVE_SUCCESS: Toast title after removing a playlist or an item from it; also used in the message as playlist name + ' ' + this word. Past participle, short.
SYSTEM.ALLOW_UI_STATISTICS: Setting label (on/off switch) on the System settings page: allow anonymous usage statistics of the web interface to be sent to Volumio.
SYSTEM.ALLOW_UI_STATISTICS_DOC: Help text under the UI statistics switch on the System settings page; privacy notice. Keep the URL volumio.com/privacy-policy unchanged.
SYSTEM.CANNOT_REMOVE_MEDIA: Error toast message when a storage device (e.g. USB drive) cannot be safely removed/ejected; followed by ': ' and the technical error. Media = storage device.
SYSTEM.CHECKING_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: Status text in the system update progress dialog, shown at the start while the player verifies its system files before updating.
SYSTEM.CHECK_UPDATES: Button label on the System settings page that checks online for a newer version of the operating system. Verb phrase, keep short.
SYSTEM.CHECK_UPDATES_DESCR: Description shown next to the Check Updates button on the System settings page.
SYSTEM.CREDITS_OPEN_SOURCE_LICENSES: Section title and button on the System settings page opening the list of credits and licenses of the open-source software used by the system.
SYSTEM.DELETE_FOLDER: Toast title for deleting a music folder from the library browser (e.g. on USB or internal storage). Verb phrase; message below is an error or progress.
SYSTEM.DELETE_USER_DATA: Button label on the System settings page that erases the user's settings, favorites and playlists (music files stay). Verb phrase. No render site found.
SYSTEM.DELETE_USER_DATA_DESCR: Description next to the Delete User Data button on the System settings page. No render site found.
SYSTEM.DELETE_USER_DATA_MESSAGE: Body of the confirmation dialog after pressing Delete User Data; user answers yes/no. USB and NAS = music on USB drives and network storage. No render site found.
SYSTEM.DELETE_USER_DATA_TITLE: Title of the confirmation dialog after pressing Delete User Data on the System settings page. Confirm = imperative verb. No render site found.
SYSTEM.DELETING_FOLDER: Fragment of a progress toast while deleting a music folder, followed by a space and the folder path. Currently unused (commented out in code).
SYSTEM.ERROR_DELETING_FOLDER: Error toast message (title: Delete folder) when a music folder could not be deleted from storage.
SYSTEM.FACTORY_RESET: Button label on the System settings page that erases all settings and restores the player to its original state. Asks for confirmation first.
SYSTEM.FACTORY_RESET_DESCR: Description shown next to the Factory Reset button on the System settings page.
SYSTEM.FACTORY_RESET_MESSAGE: Body of the confirmation dialog after pressing Factory Reset on the System settings page; user answers yes/no. Device restarts afterwards.
SYSTEM.FACTORY_RESET_TITLE: Title of the confirmation dialog after pressing Factory Reset on the System settings page. Confirm = imperative verb.
SYSTEM.FULL_SETTINGS_SET: Option in the settings-mode selector on the System settings page: show all settings, including advanced ones (opposite of a simplified set). Short select option.
SYSTEM.FULL_SETTINGS_SET_EXTENDED: Longer first-person option text for choosing the full (advanced) settings mode, e.g. in the first-run wizard; opposite of the simple settings option.
SYSTEM.GENERAL_SETTINGS: Section title on the System settings page grouping basic options (player name, settings mode, etc.).
SYSTEM.HDMI_UI: Setting label (on/off switch) on the System settings page: show the player's user interface on a screen/TV connected to the HDMI port.
SYSTEM.HDMI_UI_DOC: Help text under the HDMI user interface switch on the System settings page; warns that turning it on makes the system slower. Keep WARNING emphasized.
SYSTEM.INSTALLING_TO_DISK: Title of the progress dialog while the system copies itself from the SD card/USB stick to an internal disk (Install to Disk feature).
SYSTEM.INSTALLING_TO_DISK_ERROR_MESSAGE: Error message in the Install to Disk dialog, followed by ': ' and the technical error reason.
SYSTEM.INSTALLING_TO_DISK_ERROR_TARGET_S: Error in the Install to Disk dialog: the chosen target disk is smaller than the disk the system runs from, so it cannot be installed there.
SYSTEM.INSTALLING_TO_DISK_MESSAGE: Progress message in the Install to Disk dialog, shown while the system is being copied to the internal disk.
SYSTEM.INSTALLING_TO_DISK_SUCCESS_MESSAG: Body of the Install to Disk completion dialog, with a Restart button: reboot and unplug the SD card/USB stick to start from the new disk.
SYSTEM.INSTALLING_TO_DISK_SUCCESS_TITLE: Title of the dialog shown when the system has been copied to the internal disk successfully.
SYSTEM.INSTALL_TO_DISK: Title of the System settings section (and button prefix: this + space + disk name) for copying the operating system onto an internal disk. Verb phrase.
SYSTEM.INSTALL_TO_DISK_DESC: Fragment of a button description in the Install to Disk section, followed by ': ', the disk name, then the size label and size. Verb phrase.
SYSTEM.INSTALL_TO_DISK_LABEL: No render site found; in the Install to Disk area of System settings, likely a caption for a target disk's label (the volume name of the drive). Uppercase caption style like 'SIZE'.
SYSTEM.INSTALL_TO_DISK_MESSAGE: Start of the confirmation dialog body when installing Volumio onto another disk from System settings; code appends a space, the disk name, its size, '. ' then the data-loss warning.
SYSTEM.INSTALL_TO_DISK_MESSAGE_WARNING: End of the Install to Disk confirmation dialog, appended after the disk name and size; the target disk will be completely erased. Keep the leading period and space as in English.
SYSTEM.INSTALL_TO_DISK_SIZE: Caption in the Install to Disk button description on System settings, followed by ': ' and the disk's capacity (e.g. 32GB). Storage size noun, uppercase caption style.
SYSTEM.KEEP_PRESSED_TO_TURN_OFF_IN: No render site found; power-off countdown text while the user holds the power button, followed by the number of seconds left before the device shuts down.
SYSTEM.MEDIA_REMOVED_SUCCESSFULLY: Success toast (used as both title and message) after a USB drive or other removable storage is safely ejected/unmounted from the device.
SYSTEM.NO_UPDATE_AVAILABLE: Title of the update check result (System updates section / update dialog) when no newer Volumio OS version exists; refers to system software updates.
SYSTEM.PLAYER_NAME: Input label on the System settings page: the device's name as shown to other devices and apps on the network (also its hostname).
SYSTEM.PLAYER_NAME_DOC: Help text under the Player Name field on the System settings page; 'system' = this Volumio device, 'network' = the home network.
SYSTEM.PRIVACY_SETTINGS: Section title on the System settings page grouping privacy options (e.g. sharing anonymous usage/diagnostic data).
SYSTEM.SHOW_ADVANCED_SETTINGS: Select label on the System settings page choosing between full (advanced) and simplified settings mode; options are 'Full Settings Mode' / 'Simplified Settings Mode'.
SYSTEM.SHOW_ADVANCED_SETTINGS_DOC: Help text under the Show Advanced Settings select on the System settings page; 'tweakings' = fine adjustments of technical options.
SYSTEM.SIMPLE_SETTINGS_SET: Option in the Show Advanced Settings select on the System settings page: show only the essential settings, hiding expert options. Pairs with the full settings option.
SYSTEM.SIMPLE_SETTINGS_SET_EXTENDED: First-person option label in a settings-mode chooser (paired with the full/advanced option): pick a reduced set of settings with expert options hidden.
SYSTEM.STARTING_SOFTWARE_UPDATE: Status text in the system update progress dialog right after the user starts a Volumio OS update, before download progress appears.
SYSTEM.STARTUP_SOUND: Switch label on the System settings page: a short sound the device plays when it finishes booting.
SYSTEM.STARTUP_SOUND_DOC: Help text under the Startup Sound switch on the System settings page; 'ready to play' = ready for music playback.
SYSTEM.SUCCESSFULLY_DELETED_FOLDER: Success toast message (title 'Delete folder') after the user deletes a folder from the music library while browsing local or USB storage.
SYSTEM.SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION_UPDATE: Title of the toast shown after saving General settings on the System page (e.g. player name, kernel profile). Noun phrase: configuration was updated.
SYSTEM.SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION_UPDATE_SUCCE: Success toast message after saving settings on the System settings page.
SYSTEM.SYSTEM_INTEGRITY_CHECK_FAILED: Body of the 'Update failed' dialog: the OS update was blocked because system files were modified by hand; Factory Reset and Delete User Data are names of System page actions.
SYSTEM.SYSTEM_NAME: Title of the toasts shown when the device name (network hostname) is changed, either success or failure. Noun phrase.
SYSTEM.SYSTEM_NAME_ERROR: Alert toast message (title 'System Name') when the new device name could not be applied on the network.
SYSTEM.SYSTEM_NAME_NOW: Success toast message after renaming the device; code appends a space and the new device name.
SYSTEM.SYSTEM_SETTINGS: Page title of the System settings page (player name, startup sound, updates, privacy, factory reset).
SYSTEM.SYSTEM_UPDATES: Section title on the System settings page for Volumio OS software updates (check for updates, automatic updates and their time window).
SYSTEM.TURN_OFF_IN: No render site found; shutdown countdown text followed by the number of seconds left before the device powers off.
SYSTEM.UPDATE_ALREADY_LATEST_VERSION: Message under 'No Updates Available' in the system update check result: the installed Volumio OS is the newest version.
SYSTEM.UPDATE_FAILED: Title of the dialog shown when a Volumio OS software update cannot be performed (e.g. failed integrity check).
SYSTEM.VIDEO_OUT_OPTIONS: Section title on the System settings page for video output options (HDMI display/screen output of the device). Usually hidden.
SYSTEM.AUTOMATIC_UPDATES: Switch label in the System updates section of the System settings page; lets the device install Volumio OS updates by itself.
SYSTEM.AUTOMATIC_UPDATES_DOC: Description under the Automatic updates switch on the System settings page; the timezone matters because updates run only in a chosen time window.
SYSTEM.AUTOMATIC_UPDATES_START_TIME: Select label in System updates on the System settings page: the hour when the daily period allowed for automatic updates begins (options are times of day).
SYSTEM.AUTOMATIC_UPDATES_START_TIME_DOC: Description under the update window start-time select on the System settings page (same as its label): hour when the allowed automatic-update period begins.
SYSTEM.AUTOMATIC_UPDATES_STOP_TIME: Select label in System updates on the System settings page: the hour when the daily period allowed for automatic updates ends (options are times of day).

ONBOARDING.CONNECTION_DEVICE: Screen-reader label (aria-label) of the network icon in the side menu entry that opens network settings; tells the user it is where to connect the player to Wi-Fi or Ethernet.
ONBOARDING.SETTINGS_SYSTEM: Screen-reader label (aria-label) of the gear icon in the side menu entry that opens the System settings page (general device settings).
ONBOARDING.PLUGINS: Screen-reader label (aria-label) of the puzzle-piece icon in the side menu entry for Plugins, where users add music streaming services and other add-ons.
ONBOARDING.OTHER_SETTINGS: No render site found; likely a guided-tour title for the row of small side-menu buttons: alarm clock, sleep timer, help/info and the Volumio shop. Keep the slash-separated list.
ONBOARDING.STANDBY_RESTART: No render site found; likely a guided-tour title for the side-menu power button, which puts the device in standby or restarts it. Nouns/verbs for power actions.
ACCESSIBILITY.GO_BACK: Screen-reader label (aria-label) of the left-chevron back button in the audio outputs panel; returns to the previous view of the panel. Verb phrase.
ACCESSIBILITY.PLAYBACK_OPTIONS: Screen-reader label (aria-label) of the gear icon in the audio outputs panel and of the side-menu Playback Options entry; opens the audio output/playback settings page.
ACCESSIBILITY.PLAY_HERE_SELECTED: Screen-reader label (aria-label) of the phone icon in the audio outputs panel when 'play on this device' (local playback in the browser/phone) is active. State: selected.
ACCESSIBILITY.LOADING: Screen-reader label (aria-label) of the spinning icon in the audio outputs panel while local playback on this phone/browser is buffering. Status, short.
ACCESSIBILITY.OPEN_MENU: Screen-reader label (aria-label) of the chevron on Grouping/Cast buttons in the audio outputs panel and of the hamburger icon of the side menu; opens that menu. Verb phrase.
ACCESSIBILITY.CLOSE_MENU: Screen-reader label (aria-label) of the X icon that closes the side menu or the audio outputs panel. Verb phrase.
ACCESSIBILITY.REPEAT_SELECTED: No render site found; likely screen-reader label of the Repeat playback button when repeat is turned on. State: repeat is selected/active.
ACCESSIBILITY.LOGO: No render site found; likely screen-reader alternative text for the Volumio logo image in the web UI header. Brand name stays as is.
ACCESSIBILITY.SOURCES: Screen-reader label (aria-label) of the input-jack icon in the side menu entry that opens the music sources settings (where music comes from: drives, inputs, services). Noun, plural.
ACCESSIBILITY.SHUTDOWN: Screen-reader label (aria-label) of the power icon button in the side menu, which opens power off/restart actions. Noun/verb for turning the device off.
ACCESSIBILITY.ALARM: Screen-reader label (aria-label) of the alarm-clock icon button in the side menu; opens the alarm (wake-up music) settings.
ACCESSIBILITY.SLEEP: Screen-reader label (aria-label) of the sleep icon button in the side menu; opens the sleep timer that stops playback or turns off after a set time.
ACCESSIBILITY.SHOP: Screen-reader label (aria-label) of the basket icon button in the side menu; opens the Volumio online store page. Brand name stays as is.
ACCESSIBILITY.SLIDER: Screen-reader label (aria-label) of the playback seek bar on the now-playing screen, used to move to a position in the track. Noun, generic control name.
